105:t_1:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...So $$刹那$$ and the others were looking into $$ネオ・ジオン$$ on their own, huh.」

105:t_1:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「Sorry. Colonel $$シャア$$'s whereabouts are still unknown.」

105:t_1:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He's doing his own thing. We've got no reason to worry about him.」

105:t_1:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But looking at it the other way, the fact that we can't reach $$シャア$$ means the forces of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ under $$フル・フロンタル$$ must be that large.」

105:t_1:8.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Exactly. If the $$地球連邦$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ fought head-on now, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ would undoubtedly win.」

105:t_1:9.en:
$$エマ$$
「The Federation and $$ジオン$$... In the wars so far the Federation had the greater national power, but that's been reversed too, hasn't it.」

105:t_1:10.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That said, their home ground is space. They probably won't throw everything they have into attacking Earth.」

105:t_1:11.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「That's right. If it came to that, they'd even clash with the $$新地球皇国$$.」

105:t_1:14.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「...Did I... say something strange?」

105:t_1:15.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「It's not your fault, $$ハサウェイ$$.」

105:t_1:16.en:
$$マリー$$
「But something you'd never imagine... no, something you wouldn't want to imagine... may actually be happening.」

105:t_1:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Exactly that. There is a possibility that $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is in league with the $$サイデリアル$$.」

105:t_1:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It's true that he... that $$フル・フロンタル$$ said he would follow the $$ジェミニス$$ after dropping $$アクシズ$$, but...!」

105:t_1:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But...! But if they do something like that, the fighting will only spread, won't it!」

105:t_1:25.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「At this point it's only a possibility. It will all become clear here in North America.」

105:t_1:26.en:
$$刹那$$
「A land where the $$地球連邦$$ and the $$新地球皇国$$ fight evenly matched... The reactivated $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will surely intervene there.」

105:t_1:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This continent's $$レイライン$$s also gather at the $$ターミナル・ベース$$s that govern each region, and are then bundled at the $$セントラル・ベース$$, the core.」

105:t_1:28.en:
$$カツ$$
「So our objective is to hit that $$セントラル・ベース$$, right?」

105:t_1:29.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We were able to resupply with the supplies from $$ソレスタルビーイング$$. All that's left is to advance.」

105:t_1:30.en:
$$イアン$$
「Sorry, Captain. I wanted to get you a somewhat better mobile suit, since you've been struggling, but...」

105:t_1:31.en:
$$イアン$$
「Everything is such a mess all over that I couldn't even follow up on my connections.」

105:t_1:32.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Please don't worry about it, $$イアン$$. The $$リ・ガズィ$$ isn't a bad machine.」

105:t_1:33.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$刹那$$ is fighting in the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ too. I can't ask for luxuries either.」

105:t_1:34.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Remember this, $$ハサウェイ$$. This is what they mean by 'a difference in mobile suit performance is not the decisive difference in fighting strength.'」

105:t_1:35.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I get that, but whose words are they?」

105:t_1:37.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Never mind, $$タクヤ$$. ...But the difference in maintenance does decide fighting strength... I'm counting on you to tune the $$リ・ガズィ$$.」

105:t_1:39.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$タクヤ$$'s amazing. To be trusted with the maintenance by Captain $$アムロ$$.」

105:t_1:40.en:
$$ミコット$$
「$$タクヤ$$... he works hard every day. He says, 'I'm a member of $c too.'」

105:t_1:41.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$タクヤ$$, $$ミコット$$, and I have all kept fighting, from the battle at $$インダストリアル７$$ up to today...)

105:t_1:42.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$オードリー$$... What are you doing right now...)

105:t_1:44.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Are you perhaps remembering your family?」

105:t_1:45.en:
$n
「No... I've already settled things with Dad and Sis in my own heart.」

105:t_1:46.en:
$n
「It's just that the old 《$$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$》 is where I lived before I came to Tokyo, so it's been on my mind...」

105:t_1:47.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Now that you mention it, that's right.」

105:t_1:48.en:
$n
「I was living deep in the Rocky Mountains, so what was going on in society didn't really affect me, though.」

105:t_1:49.en:
$n
「But sometimes I think... if $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$ were still alive, maybe North America wouldn't have been hit this badly...」

105:t_1:50.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「The $$ブリタニア$$ Emperor, huh...」

105:t_1:52.en:
$n
「I've heard about $$ゼロ$$ and Emperor $$シャルル$$ from $$甲児$$.」

105:t_1:53.en:
$n
「Setting aside what kind of person he was, I could feel Emperor $$シャルル$$'s leadership and charisma myself.」

105:t_1:54.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「True enough. We who actually fought him know it all too well.」

105:t_1:55.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'm curious myself what moves Emperor $$シャルル$$ would have made against a powerful invader, had he lived.」

105:t_1:56.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That man was self-righteous, but in his own way he was trying to steer the world in a good direction.」

105:t_1:57.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「But that never got through to his son.」

105:t_1:58.en:
$$マリー$$
「Even though they're parent and child... no, precisely because they're parent and child, it's sad when they can't understand each other.」

105:t_1:59.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「In that respect... Commander $$碇$$ of $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ and $$シンジ$$ are alike too.」

105:t_1:60.en:
$$刹那$$
「But someone who can easily cast others aside for their own goals cannot lead the world.」

105:t_1:63.en:
$n
「W-what is it, $$刹那$$? Are you aiming to stop being the quiet type too...」

105:t_1:64.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n... so it really did bother you...)

105:t_1:68.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「It's the kind of exchange that makes the listener squirm.」

105:t_1:69.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But it really shows, you know. Looking at $$刹那$$ and $n now.」

105:t_1:70.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「True. They might stop being the quiet type soon, too.」

105:t_1:71.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$ヒイロ$$, $$キリコ$$ and $$宗介$$ may be the same.」

105:t_1:72.en:
$$イアン$$
「Come on, $$ティエリア$$. That's rich, leaving yourself out of it like that.」

105:t_1:74.en:
$$イアン$$
「You've changed too, you know. For the better, of course.」

105:t_1:76.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Surroundings matter a lot to boys and girls in their growing years. Friendships most of all.」

105:t_1:77.en:
$n
「Oh... please don't tell $$宗介$$, $$甲児$$, and the others about this.」

105:t_1:80.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hehe... even your bashfulness is boyish, and I like it.」

105:t_1:81.en:
$$マリー$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is just like $n's mother.」

105:t_1:82.en:
$$スズネ$$
「At least make it an older sister!」
